title: Legacy Plot Community Garden Dilemma
setting: Nestled between a laundromat and a row of bungalows, Maplewood’s community garden has been tended by two generations of local families. Three decades ago, a group of original retiree gardeners carved out the plots, and now their adult children oversee the space alongside younger neighbors. Last month, a city zoning notice threatened to repurpose half the garden for a municipal parking lot, splitting the new garden stewards over whether to negotiate or protest.

characters.name: Marisol
characters.tendencies: She tracks volunteer hours, plot yields, and donated supplies to mediate conflicting requests for garden space.

characters.name: Javi
characters.tendencies: He shares oral histories of the original garden’s founding to rally community members against the zoning proposal.

characters.name: Lila
characters.tendencies: She maintains the garden’s tools and raised beds, and mentors young apprentice gardeners to carry on the original growers’ practices.
